contentList.content: Mislead
Become <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="INVISIBILITY">invisible</LSTag> at the same time that an illusory double of you appears where you are standing.
An illusory double of its caster can move and cause distractions.
Illusory Double
Distract
Mislead: Control Double
Become controlled by your caster so you can move and cause distractions.
Controlling Double
Entity is using the senses of its illusory double and is <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="BLINDED">blinded</LSTag>.
Command your illusory double to move and cause distractions. You become <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="BLINDED">blinded</LSTag> in regard to your own surroundings.
Zone of Truth

Create a magical zone that guards against deception in a [1] radius sphere centered on you. A creature that enters the spell's area for the first time on a turn or starts its turn there must make a <LSTag Tooltip="Charisma">Charisma</LSTag> <LSTag Tooltip="SavingThrow">saving throw</LSTag> or have a penalty on <LSTag Tooltip="Deception">Deception</LSTag> rolls while in the radius. Additionally, you have <LSTag Tooltip="Advantage">advantage</LSTag> on <LSTag Tooltip="Insight">Insight</LSTag> rolls for the spell's duration.

While in the aura, affected entities have a penalty on <LSTag Tooltip="Deception">Deception</LSTag> rolls, and the originating caster has <LSTag Tooltip="Advantage">advantage</LSTag> on <LSTag Tooltip="Insight">Insight</LSTag> rolls.
Half Cover
Entity has a +2 bonus to <LSTag Tooltip="ArmorClass">AC</LSTag> and Dexterity <LSTag Tooltip="SavingThrow">saving throws</LSTag>.

Twilight Domain

The twilit transition from light into darkness often brings calm and even joy, as the day's labors end and the hours of rest begin. The darkness can also bring terrors, but the gods of twilight guard against the horrors of the night. Clerics who serve these deities bring comfort to those who seek rest and protect them by venturing into the encroaching darkness to ensure that the dark is a comfort, not a terror.
Twilight
Twilight Domain Spells
The Twilight Domain gives you access to certain spells. These are <LSTag Tooltip="AlwaysPrepared">Always Prepared</LSTag>.
Eyes of Night
You can see in the dark up to [1]. As an <LSTag Type="ActionResource" Tooltip="ActionPoint">action</LSTag>, you can share your darkvision with a number of allies equal to your Wisdom modifier.
Magically share the darkvision granted by your <LSTag Type="Passive" Tooltip="EyesofNight">Eyes of Night</LSTag> feature with a number of allies equal to your Wisdom modifier.
You can share this feature with a number of allies equal to your Wisdom modifier once per <LSTag Tooltip="LongRest">long rest</LSTag>, or by expending a spell slot to share it again.
Vigilant Blessing
Grant yourself or an ally a +[1] bonus to initiative.
Affected entity has a +[1] bonus to its next initiative roll.
This benefit ends immediately after initiative is rolled or if you use this feature again.
Twilight Sanctuary

Emanate dim twilight in a [1] radius sphere. Whenever you or an ally ends their turn within the area, you can either grant them [2] + [3] or end the effects causing them to be <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="CHARMED">charmed</LSTag> or <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="FRIGHTENED">frightened</LSTag>.
The effect will end early if you become <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="INCAPACITATED">incapacitated</LSTag> or die.
Twilight Sanctuary: Temporary Hit Points
Grant [1] + [2] to yourself or an ally that ends their turn inside the area of your <LSTag Type="Spell" Tooltip="Shout_TwilightSanctuary">Twilight Sanctuary</LSTag>.
Twilight Sanctuary: Remove Charm

End any effects causing you or an ally to be <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="CHARMED">charmed</LSTag> when they end their turn inside the area of your <LSTag Type="Spell" Tooltip="Shout_TwilightSanctuary">Twilight Sanctuary</LSTag>.
Twilight Sanctuary: Remove Fear

End any effects causing you or an ally to be <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="FRIGHTENED">frightened</LSTag> when they end their turn inside the area of your <LSTag Type="Spell" Tooltip="Shout_TwilightSanctuary">Twilight Sanctuary</LSTag>.
Steps of Night
The Twilight deities grant their Clerics the ability to draw on the mystical power of night and rise into the air a number of times equal to their proficiency bonus.
Gain the ability to <LSTag Type="Spell" Tooltip="Projectile_StepsofNight">Fly</LSTag> when in dim light or darkness.
Can <LSTag Type="Spell" Tooltip="Projectile_StepsofNight">fly</LSTag> to a target position when in dim light or darkness.
Steps of Night: Fly
The extra damage increases when you reach 14th level.
Twilight Shroud

You and your allies have <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="SRD_HALF_COVER">half cover</LSTag> cover while in the sphere created by your <LSTag Type="Spell" Tooltip="Shout_TwilightSanctuary">Twilight Sanctuary</LSTag>.

Order Domain

Clerics of Order believe that well-crafted laws establish legitimate hierarchies, and those selected by law to lead must be obeyed. Those who obey must do so to the best of their ability, and if those who lead fail to protect the law, they must be replaced. In this manner, law weaves a web of obligations that create order and security in a chaotic multiverse.
Order
Order Domain Spells
The Order Domain gives you access to certain spells. These are <LSTag Tooltip="AlwaysPrepared">Always Prepared</LSTag>.
Voice of Authority

If you cast a spell with a <LSTag Tooltip="SpellSlot">spell slot</LSTag> of 1st level or higher and target an ally with the spell, that ally can use their <LSTag Type="ActionResource" Tooltip="ReactionActionPoint">reaction</LSTag> to immediately make a weapon attack against an enemy within range.
Emboldened
Can be directed to attack an enemy within range.
Must have enemy in range of active weapon or unarmed strike.
Direct an ally to use their <LSTag Type="ActionResource" Tooltip="ReactionActionPoint">reaction</LSTag> and attack a nearby foe.
<LSTag Type="Image" Info="SoftWarning"/> The ally must have an enemy in range of its active weapon or unarmed strike.
Emboldened Attack
Attack a random target within range of your active weapon or unarmed strike.
Order's Demand
Attempt to <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="ORDERS_DEMAND_CHARM">charm</LSTag> and <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="DISARM">disarm</LSTag> all targets within [1] that can hear or see you.
<LSTag Type="Image" Info="SoftWarning"/> Condition ends early if the target takes any damage.
Embodiment of the Law
Clerics of Order can compel others more efficiently a number of times equal to their Wisdom modifier.

Enchantment spells of 1st level or higher are cast using a bonus action.

Costs [1] use of Embodiment of the Law per spell.
Order's Wrath

When you deal damage with your <LSTag Type="Spell" Tooltip="Target_DivineStrike_Order_Container">Divine Strike</LSTag> on your turn, you curse the target until the start of your next turn. The next time an ally hits the cursed creature with an attack, it takes an additional [1].
Cursed: Order's Wrath
Will take [1] additional damage from next attack.
